skins.name: Caged Singer
skins.content: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Caged Singer. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will spurn not the cage but accept her shackles, so she might continue to sing.
skins.usage: One of Uika Misumi's Terran stage costumes.
skins.quote: Draped in lies, she confronts that for which she sorrows.
